notes.title: localization update and other
notes.content:
I sometimes go back to my old games to update something or improve something.
This time I've
- reworked the ui. 
- changed two puzzles and their passwords.
- rewrote most of the game code ( you won't see it, but I want someone to know =) )
- changed the way of entering passwords in the dungeon. Now you do not have to jump on the slab, but just press the interactive button.
- Added localization in several languages.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Thanks for making comments and reviews on the game, it helps me make the game better.


In this patch I added: 
- a designation of what items the player has.
- Improved the interface.
- interaction with most objects is carried out through the action button, and not itself, as it was before.
-Changed the sound - indicating the solution of the puzzle in some places

The most important thing. Made a clearer puzzle with angels. One angel is now not moving and is directed in the right direction.

The visual part of the game was also improved and optimization was added.

Also, many bugs have been fixed.
